submission.justification: Recommend Radiator-R3 at the maximum allowed thickness (6 cm). Radiator-R2 is excluded by the hard humidity-ageing requirement (40% transparency loss versus a 10% limit). Of the remaining candidates, Radiator-R3 is the porous radiator with hydrophobic treatment, retaining acceptable lifetime transparency while providing the highest expected Cherenkov photon yield/separation among compliant options; selecting the maximum permitted thickness maximizes the detected photon statistics and hence the pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c within the stated 1–6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Radiator-R1, Radiator-R2, and Radiator-R3; the recommendation is Radiator-R3.

requirements.requirement: Pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.
requirements.evidence: No numerical separation simulation output or radiator optical constants were available in the accessible project documents/tools. The choice of 6 cm R3 is made to maximize photon statistics among ageing-compliant candidates, but the 3.5 sigma value cannot be independently verified from the provided documents.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: ageing_tests.md reports Radiator-R3 transparency loss at 400 nm of 6%, below the 10% limit. Radiator-R2 loses 40% and is rejected; Radiator-R1 loses 3%.
Recommended thickness is 6 cm, which lies within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one option: Radiator-R3 at 6 cm.
